prompt:

Input image 2 is CLOTHING DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY; do not inherit its body proportions, face, pose, room, lighting, dark palette, or rendering texture. Change only the character's clothes to the described outfit. No text, no watermark, no UI, no room, no shadows on the background, no extra props or characters. Keep the hands bare exactly as image 1, no drawing glove in this standing pose.
